changes: Stop hook roadblock check stays on

Today `unattended on` turns every switch off except autosave, including the handover switch that gates the Stop hook where roadblock_check runs (core.py 2749, hook.py 101). The stall scan and the goal check from #588 to #591 therefore never run in a real unattended session; bypass mode is unaffected.
Unattended mode turns the Stop hook off.
The roadblock and goal checks keep running there, split from the handover command check.
Unattended runs stop stalling, which is the point of the fix.
choices: How should the roadblock and goal checks run in unattended mode?
Keep them on inside the Stop hook, with the rest of the hook off
Smallest change; matches your goal that unattended runs never stall.
Run them from a different hook that unattended leaves on
Works, but adds a second hook to keep in step.
Drop them from unattended; keep only the bypass behaviour
Leaves unattended runs able to stall, which this fix exists to stop.
A is one split in the switch list and no new hook.
